identity.what_it_is: A fishing-village beach on the Bay of Bengal near Chirala; a former minor port that wound down by Indian independence and is now a working fishing town and a weekend beach draw for Hyderabad/Telangana tourists, with an active proposal to develop it into a resort corridor.
identity.where: Chirala mandal, on India's east coast. Wikipedia's infobox and the official Bapatla district government portal place it in Bapatla district; Wikidata, onefivenine, Tripadvisor's URL slug, and a 2025 press article still label it Prakasam district (Ongole) — likely an artifact of the 2022 split of Bapatla out of Prakasam/Guntur that not all sources have caught up with.
identity.warnings: District attribution conflict (Bapatla vs Prakasam) unresolved across sources post-2022 reorg. No Telugu-language Wikipedia article was found for the beach itself; treat the local-language name as under-sourced beyond the onefivenine village page's Telugu script.

spike_candidates.statement: In October 2025, three VIT-Amaravati students drowned and two more people went missing in a single day at Vodarevu Beach after being swept away by strong currents.
spike_candidates.tension: The fishing-village, calm-sea image sits uneasily against a beach that has repeatedly killed weekend tourists in rip currents, including a Hyderabad woman in 2023.

spike_candidates.statement: In May 2025 the AP Chambers of Commerce proposed a 20-km Suryalanka-Vodarevu coastal corridor that could add 20-25 high-end resorts, branding it a future 'Mini Goa'.
spike_candidates.tension: A narrative of an untouched, commercial-free fishing beach ignores active state-backed development plans and the resorts already operating nearby.

spike_candidates.statement: Official Bapatla district sources place Vodarevu Beach in Bapatla district while Wikidata and a 2025 press article still call it Prakasam district.
spike_candidates.tension: Even government and reference sources cannot agree which district the beach sits in, three years after Bapatla was carved out of Prakasam.

facts.fact: Vodarevu Beach lies about 6 km from Chirala on the Bay of Bengal coast, in Chirala mandal, Bapatla district per Wikipedia's infobox.
facts.quote: vodarevu beach is located about 6 km from chirala on the east coast of bay of bengal .

facts.fact: Wikipedia gives the beach's coordinates as 15°47′44″N 80°24′51″E.
Vodarevu is described as the shortest-distance beach from Hyderabad and Telangana, drawing large numbers of weekend tourists from there.
facts.quote: vodarevu beach is shortest distance beach from hyderabad and telangana every week end lot of tourists from hyderabad and telangana visiting here.

facts.fact: Coconut trees line the shore at Vodarevu Beach.
facts.quote: coconut trees line the shore.

facts.fact: Wikidata's structured record locates Vodarevu Beach in Prakasam district, conflicting with newer Bapatla-district sources.
facts.quote: located in the administrative territorial entity prakasam district

facts.fact: Wikidata records a slightly different coordinate pair for the beach than Wikipedia's infobox.
facts.quote: coordinate location 15°48'0"n, 80°24'59"e

facts.fact: The official Bapatla district portal puts Vodarevu 8 km from Chirala and describes it as a top-visited beach for water sports, fishing, and boat rides.
facts.quote: located 8 km from chirala, vodarevu is one of the most visited beaches, offering exciting water sport activities and fishing options. boat rides are also available.
facts.source_title: Vodarevu Beach - Bapatla District Government Portal

facts.fact: The Bapatla district government's Vodarevu Beach page was last updated on 19 August 2026, confirming the water-sport/fishing/boat-ride description is current.
facts.quote: last updated: aug 19, 2026
facts.source_title: Vodarevu Beach - Bapatla District Government Portal

facts.fact: Nearby Suryalanka Beach, about 9 km from Bapatla, already has many resorts clustered close to it.
facts.quote: suryalanka beach or bapatla beach and it is located approximately 9 kilometers from bapatla the place has many resorts close to the beach.

facts.fact: Ramapuram Beach, near Chirala mandal like Vodarevu, is described by the district portal as one of the cleanest and most peaceful beaches in the area.
facts.quote: considered to be one of the cleanest and most peaceful beaches, ramapuram boasts of serenity

facts.fact: Chirala, the nearest town to Vodarevu, had a 2011 census population of 172,826.
facts.quote: the city had a population of 172,826

facts.fact: Vodarevu and Ramapuram are Chirala's most famous beaches, with a hospitality industry growing around them due to state government focus.
facts.quote: vodarevu and ramapuram are the most famous, with the hospitality industry blooming in their vicinity owing to the state government's increasing focus.

facts.fact: In April 2026 the APTDC chief reviewed Rs 97.52 crore in development works underway at nearby Suryalanka Beach.
facts.quote: aptdc chief reviews rs 97.52 crore development works at suryalanka beach
facts.source_title: The New Indian Express (cited in Chirala - Wikipedia)

facts.fact: Chirala, and by extension the Vodarevu coast, has an average annual temperature of 28.5°C due to its position on the Bay of Bengal.
facts.quote: the average annual temperature records at 28.5 °c (83.3 °f)

facts.fact: National Highway 216 passes through Chirala, connecting Ongole with Kattipudi, the main road route toward Vodarevu.
facts.quote: the national highway 216 passes through the town, which connects ongole with kattipudi .

facts.fact: Chirala, the governing town nearest Vodarevu, is a first-grade municipality constituted on 1 December 1940 with 33 election wards.
facts.quote: it is a first grade municipality, constituted on 1 december 1940 and has a jurisdictional area of 13.57 km 2 (5.24 sq mi) with 33 election wards.

facts.fact: Handloom weaving is one of Chirala's main industries, alongside the coastal fishing economy that includes Vodarevu.
facts.quote: handloom weaving industry is one of the main industries the city.

facts.fact: Vodarevu village sits at an elevation of about 8 meters above sea level.
facts.quote: elevation / altitude: 8 meters. above seal level

facts.fact: The village profile records an alternate spelling of the place name as 'Vadarevu'.
facts.quote: alternate village name : vadarevu

facts.fact: Vodarevu is about 59 km north of the (former) district headquarters Ongole and 310 km from state capital Hyderabad.
facts.quote: it is located 59 km towards north from district head quarters ongole. 310 km from state capital hyderabad

facts.fact: The nearest airport to Vodarevu is Vijayawada Airport, about 100 km away.
facts.quote: vijayawada airport 100 km near

facts.fact: Chirala and Ipurupalem railway stations are the nearest rail stations to Vodarevu.
facts.quote: chirala rail way station , ipurupalem rail way station are the very nearby railway stations to vodarevu.

facts.fact: VRS & YRN College of Engineering & Technology is located on Vodarevu Road in Chirala, marking the road to the beach.
facts.quote: vrs & yrn college of engineering & technology address : vodarevu road, chirala - 523 157, prakasam dist.

facts.fact: National highways NH544D and NH216 are listed as reachable from Vodarevu.
facts.quote: nationa high way :nh544d nationa high way :nh216

facts.fact: Mappls lists Vodarevu Beach as open daily from 11:00 to 01:00.
facts.quote: opening hours open: mon-sun 11:00-01:00

facts.fact: Lalitananda Ashram at Vadarevu, near Chirala, was established by Lalitananda Swami roughly 70 years ago.
facts.quote: this ashram was established by lalitananda swami about 70 years ago.

facts.fact: A Sri Rama temple was built at the Vadarevu ashram in 2004.
facts.quote: in 2004, sri rama temple was built at the ashram.

facts.fact: A large dining room and guest house were built at the Vadarevu ashram in 2003 to feed and house growing numbers of visiting devotees.
facts.quote: a big dining room and a guest house was constructed for the devotees in the ashram in 2003.

facts.fact: The 11th-century, Chola-era Adikesavaswamy temple at Vodarevu, long dilapidated, was reported in 2004 to be under reconstruction by the Sri Lalithananda Ashram.
facts.quote: the ancient adikesavaswamy temple , originally built by the cholas during the eleventh century, and now in a dilapidated condition, is being rebuilt by sri arulananda swamy, head of sri lalithananda ashram of vodarevu
facts.source_title: News - Sri Arulananda Trust (citing The Hindu, Apr. 27, 2004)

facts.fact: In January 2006 the Sri Arulananda Trust announced plans to build a mini superspeciality hospital at Vodarevu estimated to cost Rs 14 crore.
facts.quote: sri arulananda trust decided to go ahead with the construction of mini superspeciality hospital estimated to cost rs. 14 crores at vodarevu
facts.source_title: News - Sri Arulananda Trust (citing The Hindu, Jan. 24, 2006)

facts.fact: In February 2005 the Lalithananda Ashram at Vodarevu introduced an herbal siddha medicine syrup for HIV-positive patients.
facts.quote: the lalithananda ashram at vodarevu, near here, recently introduced a medicine (syrup) for hiv positive patients. it is prepared purely from herbs
facts.source_title: News - Sri Arulananda Trust (citing The Hindu, Feb. 27, 2005)

facts.fact: The ashram has published a monthly Telugu magazine, Atmajyoti, since 2004.
facts.quote: the ashram has been publishing a monthly magazine called "atmajyoti" in telugu since 2004

facts.fact: Vodarevu was a minor port that operated until the first quarter of the 20th century and wound down by Indian independence; today it is primarily a fishing town.
facts.quote: a minor port that flourished till the first quarter of the 20th century, vodarevu wound up by the time india became independent. today, it is primarily a fishing town.
facts.source_title: Vodarevu-Chirala: Call of the Sea - Outlook Traveller

facts.fact: Vodarevu's lighthouse was built specifically for local fishermen, to help guide their safe return home.
facts.quote: even the lighthouse here is especially for fishermen, built to ensure their safe return home.
facts.source_title: Vodarevu-Chirala: Call of the Sea - Outlook Traveller

facts.fact: Vodarevu itself offers no overnight stay options; visitors instead stay at two resorts in Chirala, Sea Breeze Beach Resort and Palm Coast Beach Resort.
facts.quote: vodarevu does not offer stay options for a hoiday. chirala has two resorts that you can choose from.
facts.source_title: Vodarevu-Chirala: Call of the Sea - Outlook Traveller

facts.fact: The recommended visiting season for Vodarevu is October to March.
facts.quote: when to go october to march
facts.source_title: Vodarevu-Chirala: Call of the Sea - Outlook Traveller

facts.fact: In Vodarevu, the restaurant at Sip 'n Dip serves standard North and South Indian and Chinese food.
facts.quote: in vodarevu, the restaurant at sip 'n dip serves standard north and south indian and chinese food.
facts.source_title: Vodarevu-Chirala: Call of the Sea - Outlook Traveller

facts.fact: On 12 October 2025, three VIT-Amaravati students drowned at Vodarevu Beach after strong waves swept away a group of seven who had gone swimming; two more remained missing.
facts.quote: three bodies have been recovered so far, while search operations are ongoing for the remaining two missing persons.
facts.source_title: Three VIT students drown, two missing at Vodarevu Beach - Deccan Chronicle

facts.fact: In a separate incident the same day, four bathers from a Chirala town group were swept away at Vodarevu; two were rescued and two remained missing.
facts.quote: two others - gautam krishna prasad (15) and kuchina sharon raju (18) - are still missing.
facts.source_title: Three VIT students drown, two missing at Vodarevu Beach - Deccan Chronicle

facts.fact: In October 2023, a 24-year-old Hyderabad woman named Samia drowned at Vodarevu Beach when a wave dragged her family away while they were splashing in the shallows.
facts.quote: the family of four was enjoying splashing in the waters on the seashore when a wave suddenly dragged samia, 24, inside.
facts.source_title: Hyderabad woman drowns at Vodarevu Beach in AP - Telangana Today

facts.fact: Officials noted Suryalanka and Vodarevu beaches see a huge tourist rush on weekends, and that people ignore local warnings against entering unsafe stretches of water.
facts.quote: suryalanka and vodarevu beaches witness a huge rush of tourists on the weekends. officials said despite warnings by local authorities against venturing into the waters at certain points considered unsafe, people take risks.
facts.source_title: Five students drown at beach in Andhra Pradesh - AP7AM

facts.fact: In May 2025 the AP Chambers of Commerce and Industry Federation formally proposed a coastal beach corridor linking Suryalanka (Bapatla district) and Vodarevu (Chirala, Prakasam district) to the state government.
facts.quote: the andhra pradesh chambers of commerce and industry federation (ap chambers) has submitted a representation to the state government, recommending the development of a coastal beach corridor between suryalanka (bapatla district) and vodarevu (chirala, prakasam district).
facts.source_title: Suryalanka-Vodarevu: AP Chambers for development of coastal beach corridor - The Hans India

facts.fact: The proposed 6-10 km Suryalanka-Vodarevu beach road could unlock 20-25 new high-end resorts, branding the corridor Andhra Pradesh's own 'Mini Goa'.
facts.quote: a 6-10 km beach road connecting these key tourism points would unlock opportunities for another 20-25 high-end resorts, transforming the corridor into andhra pradesh's own 'mini goa'.
facts.source_title: Suryalanka-Vodarevu: AP Chambers for development of coastal beach corridor - The Hans India

facts.fact: Outlook Traveller independently corroborates that Chirala is 6 km from Vodarevu, matching Wikipedia's figure against the district portal's 8 km claim.
facts.quote: chirala is 6 km from vodarevu
facts.source_title: Vodarevu-Chirala: Call of the Sea - Outlook Traveller
